layout.footer: You are receiving this email because of activity on your Glassfolio account. If this was not you, secure your account immediately.
layout.ignoreNotice: If you did not request this, you can safely ignore this email.
layout.securityNotice: Was this not you? Reset your password and review your security settings right away.
layout.linkFallback: Button not working? Copy this link into your browser:

confirmation.subject: Confirm your Glassfolio account
confirmation.heading: Confirm your email address
confirmation.body: Welcome to Glassfolio! Enter the code below in the app, or use the button, to verify your email address.

recovery.subject: Reset your Glassfolio password
recovery.heading: Reset your password
recovery.body: We received a request to reset your password. Use the button below to continue. You will still need your emergency recovery key to decrypt your vault.

email_change.subject: Confirm your new Glassfolio email address
email_change.heading: Confirm your new email address
email_change.body: You asked to change your Glassfolio email address to {{ .NewEmail }}. Confirm this change with the button below.

reauthentication.subject: {{ .Token }} is your Glassfolio verification code
reauthentication.heading: Confirm it's you
reauthentication.body: Enter this code in Glassfolio to confirm a sensitive action on your account.

password_changed.subject: Your Glassfolio password was changed
password_changed.heading: Your password was changed
password_changed.body: The password of your Glassfolio account ({{ .Email }}) was just changed.

email_changed.subject: Your Glassfolio email address was changed
email_changed.heading: Your email address was changed
email_changed.body: The email address of your Glassfolio account was changed from {{ .OldEmail }} to {{ .Email }}.

identity_linked.subject: A new sign-in method was linked to your Glassfolio account
identity_linked.heading: A sign-in method was linked
identity_linked.body: Your {{ .Provider }} identity is now linked to your Glassfolio account ({{ .Email }}).

identity_unlinked.subject: A sign-in method was removed from your Glassfolio account
identity_unlinked.heading: A sign-in method was removed
identity_unlinked.body: Your {{ .Provider }} identity is no longer linked to your Glassfolio account ({{ .Email }}).
